culotte.modesDesc: The twenty questions are the same. On your own, you see who makes more of the decisions in your eyes. Together, you each answer separately and find out whether you agree on who's in charge.
culotte.modeSoloDesc: You answer for both of you, based on what really happens at home.
culotte.modeDuoDesc: Take turns on the same phone, without seeing each other's answers.
culotte.setupTitreSolo: Who wears the pants in your relationship?
culotte.setupDescSolo: Twenty questions about everyday decisions: tonight's movie, the vacation, the budget, the last word in an argument... For each one, say who decides more often: you, your partner, or both of you equally.
culotte.setupTitreDuo: Which of you wears the pants?
culotte.setupDescDuo: Enter your names. The first person answers all twenty questions, hands over the phone, and the second answers in turn. The result shows who decides more, and whether you agree on it.
culotte.avertissement: Go with what really happens at home, not with what you'd like to be true. It's a game, there's no right answer!
culotte.relaisDebut: Answer without letting the other see the screen.
culotte.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Hand over the phone: their answers stay hidden until the result.
culotte.balanceLegende: Each person's share of the decisions, based on your answers
culotte.r_egal_d: Nobody's the boss at your place: decisions are split almost evenly. One of you picks the movie, the other the vacation, and you talk the rest through. That's the case for about one couple in three, according to a Pew Research Center survey in the US.
culotte.r_egal_d_solo: In your eyes, nobody's the boss: decisions are split almost evenly. Now, does {{autre}} see it the same way? Take the quiz together to find out!
culotte.r_unPeu_t: {{nom}} wears the pants a little more
culotte.r_unPeu_d: The scale tips slightly toward {{nom}}: {{nom}} is more often the one who chooses, plans or gets the last word. That's the case for lots of couples, and it works fine as long as {{autre}} still has a say on what matters most to them.
culotte.r_unPeu_d_solo: In your eyes, the scale tips slightly toward {{nom}}: {{nom}} is more often the one who chooses or gets the last word. If that suits you, all good. If not, say which things you'd like to decide a little more often.
culotte.r_unPeu_t_vous: You wear the pants a little more
culotte.r_unPeu_d_vous: Going by your answers, you're slightly more often the one who chooses, plans or gets the last word. Ask {{autre}} if that's okay with them: some people are happy not to decide everything, others would like to be asked more often.
culotte.r_plus_d: No doubt about this one: on most decisions, {{nom}} makes the call. It can work very well if {{autre}} doesn't like deciding and {{nom}} doesn't mind. But check with each other: the one who decides everything sometimes gets tired of it, and so does the one who never decides anything.
culotte.r_plus_d_solo: In your eyes, {{nom}} clearly makes the decisions at your place. If you'd like more of a say, start with one specific thing, the vacation or the weekends for example, rather than one big complaint.
culotte.r_plus_t_vous: You're the one who wears the pants
culotte.r_plus_d_vous: Going by your answers, you're mostly the one who decides: the outings, the budget, the last word. If {{autre}} lets you because it suits them, great. But ask them now and then: deciding everything also means carrying everything that goes wrong on your own.
culotte.accordTitre: Do you agree on who decides?
culotte.accordTexte: You agree on {{n}} questions out of {{total}}.
culotte.accordHaut: You see your relationship the same way: at your place, everyone knows who decides what.
culotte.accordMoyen: On the rest, you each have your own version. That's very common: we remember the decisions we made better than the ones we left to the other.
culotte.accordBas: You don't see things the same way at all. The questions where you disagree will make good things to talk about, without trying to decide who's right!
culotte.chacunMoiTitre: You each think you're the one who decides
culotte.chacunMoiNote: On these questions, you both answered “Me”.
culotte.chacunAutreTitre: You each think the other one decides
culotte.chacunAutreNote: Here, you each pointed at the other. Nobody wants those pants!
culotte.invitationDuo: It's even more fun together: you each answer separately, and you'll see whether {{autre}} agrees with you.
culotte.toutTitre: All your answers, side by side
culotte.q1: Who picks the movie or the show at night?
culotte.q3: Who picks the music in the car?
culotte.q4: Who chooses where you go on vacation?
culotte.q5: Who has the final say on the decor?
culotte.q6: Who keeps track of the money?
culotte.q7: Who decides on the big purchases?
culotte.q8: Who plans the weekends and the outings?
culotte.q9: Who says “okay, time to go” at the end of a night out?
culotte.q10: Who decides when the lights go off?
culotte.q12: Who finds it easier to say no?
culotte.q13: Who gets the last word in an argument?
culotte.q14: Who gets their way more often?
culotte.q15: Who fills up your calendar as a couple: dinners, invitations, family?
culotte.q16: Who had the final say on where you live?
culotte.q17: Who drives when the two of you go somewhere?
culotte.q18: Who decides it's time to tidy up or clean?
culotte.q19: Who makes the call when you have to decide fast?
culotte.q20: Who gets the big projects started: moving in together, taking a trip, getting a pet?
